ab_hero_t: A digital guide built for Bali, and Bali only.
ab_v1_b: Every place is checked and pinned by people who live here.
ab_v2_b: We recommend what we'd send our own friends to.
ab_v3_b: No 30 open tabs — the map, plans and booking in one flow.
ab_why_b: One island holds temples, volcanoes, reefs, rice terraces and some of the warmest people on earth — but planning it is overwhelming. We exist to make that simple.
about_mission: To empower travelers to make better decisions during their trip by providing reliable information and an innovative digital experience.
about_p1: Bali Trips is a digital platform dedicated entirely to the island of Bali — built to become the complete reference that helps travelers discover and plan their trips more easily and clearly.
about_p2: Instead of searching across dozens of scattered sites and apps, we bring trusted tourism information, distinctive places, and smart planning into a single, organized experience.
about_title: A digital guide built for Bali, and Bali only.
about_vision: To become the first digital destination for travelers exploring Bali — for first-timers and seasoned adventurers alike.
